title: Three ParA Dimers Cooperatively Assemble on Type Ia Partition Promoters.
authors: Boudsocq, Francois; Salhi, Maya; Barbe, Sophie; Bouet, Jean-Yves
one_liner_zh: 该文通过SPR和分子动力学模拟研究ParA二聚体在质粒分区启动子上的协同结合，属于蛋白质-DNA互作机制建模，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Accurate DNA segregation is essential for faithful inheritance of genetic material. In bacteria, this process is mainly ensured by partition systems composed of two proteins, ParA and ParB, and a centromere site. Auto-regulation of Par operon expression is important for efficient partitioning and is primarily mediated by ParA for type Ia plasmid partition systems. For the F-plasmid, four ParA(F) monomers were proposed to bind to four repeated sequences in the promoter region. By contrast, using quantitative surface-plasmon-resonance, we showed that three ParA(F) dimers bind to this region. We uncovered that one perfect inverted repeat (IR) motif, consisting of two hexamer sequences spaced by 28-bp, constitutes the primary ParA(F) DNA binding site. A similar but degenerated motif overlaps the former. ParA(F) binding to these motifs is well supported by biochemical and modeling analyses. Molecular dynamics simulations predict that the winged-HTH domain displays high flexibility, which may favor the cooperative ParA binding to the promoter. We propose that three ParA(F) dimers bind cooperatively to overlapping motifs, thus covering the promoter region. A similar organization is found on closely related and distant plasmid partition systems, suggesting that such promoter organization for auto-regulated Par operons is widespread and may have evolved from a common ancestor.
abstract_zh: 准确的DNA分离对于遗传物质的忠实传递至关重要。在细菌中，这一过程主要由由两种蛋白质ParA和ParB以及一个着丝粒位点组成的分配系统确保。Par操纵子表达的自动调控对于高效分配至关重要，且主要针对Ia型质粒分配系统由ParA介导。对于F质粒，曾有研究提出四个ParA(F)单体结合到启动子区域的四个重复序列上。相比之下，通过定量表面等离子体共振技术，我们展示了三个ParA(F)二聚体结合到该区域。我们发现一个由两个六聚体序列间隔28-bp组成的完美反向重复（IR）基序构成了ParA(F)的主要DNA结合位点。一个相似但简并的基序与前者重叠。ParA(F)与这些基序的结合得到了生物化学和建模分析的有力支持。分子动力学模拟预测，翼状螺旋-转角-螺旋结构域表现出高灵活性，这可能有利于ParA协同结合到启动子上。我们提出三个ParA(F)二聚体协同结合到重叠基序上，从而覆盖启动子区域。在密切相关及远缘的质粒分配系统中也发现了类似的组织结构，这表明这种用于自动调控Par操纵子的启动子组织可能广泛存在，并可能从共同祖先演化而来。
